dead_ends: Sign's constructor order is `pos, neg` (Cslib/Foundations/Logic/Tableau/Sign.lean:47-50), NOT `neg, pos` -- a naive top-to-bottom reading of a match's `.neg,.box`/`.pos,.diamond` arms suggests the wrong surviving-goal order after `rcases hs : sf.sign with _ | _ <;> rcases hf : sf.formula with ...`; the actual order is (pos,diamond) then (neg,box).

Stating a `match s, φ with ...` equality in a lemma's conclusion, with a separate hypothesis (hnbd) whose type also depends on s/φ, causes Lean's equation compiler to auto-revert that hypothesis into the compiled matcher's motive -- making the lemma permanently non-defeq to a DIFFERENT match term (e.g. one unfolded from an unrelated function definition) that has no such hypothesis in its own local context. Avoid stating lemmas this way; prefer inline rcases+dsimp at the call site instead, mirroring existing working precedent in the file.
